posts.text: The thesis of CDMO driving current growth is still valid. Q1FY27 showed solid CDMO growth on an already strong base of Q1FY26. Laurus Bio output should be material in FY29 so expecting something now is not the right thinking. ARV is the base stable cash flow. CDMO is the current growth engine, doing well with cash flows. Bio is the next incubation segment. Agree that valuations have run up, but a sell makes sense when some evidence of struggle (not a single quarter dip) is seen. Disc: Invested. Sizing grown to 7% of equity. Not selling at the moment.
